fusions.name: Rearing Slam
fusions.desc: Rears onto your hind legs and slams down, dealing 13 blunt damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and stunning them for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Mauling Rush
fusions.desc: Spends 5% of your maximum health. Your next weapon strike deals 8 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds, and your movement speed rises by 15% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Heft in Motion
fusions.desc: Raises your maximum health by 20% for 15 seconds, and your movement speed by 20% for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bulk to Bolt
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: you move and attack 5% faster per stack (27% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
